receive.title: Yudo - Yie gi jotelo e yor moro amora

api.title: API mari - Yore ariyo mag donjo ne sistem moro amora
api.intro: Sistem moro amora ma nigi API key mari nyalo loso, somo kendo loso gik ma nyalo timore kendo ndiko nying’ e chenro mag gik ma nyalo timore. Ooro funguo e wich mar <hdr></hdr> , kaka <bearer></bearer> , kata (ka gino ok nyal keto wich) kaka <query></query> . Giko: {{limit}} kwayo e dakika achiel.
